student_will_learn: Explain what EFS is and how it differs from EBS in terms of multi-instance access
Explain why EFS costs roughly 3x more than EBS per GB and when that cost is justified
Explain what Glacier Vault Lock is and how it enforces WORM (write-once-read-many) compliance
Mount an EFS filesystem across multiple EC2 instances
Identify when EFS is the wrong choice for a workload that doesn't genuinely need shared access

ava_lesson_intro.ava_speaks: Last lesson-ல நாம EBS volumes பார்த்தோம் - ஒரு volume, ஒரு instance-கூட attach ஆகும். ஆனா CFO-ஓட FQ-189 ticket-ல ஒரு புது கேள்வி - 'multiple servers, ஒரே shared files-ஐ access பண்ணணும்னா, என்ன பண்றது?' இதுதான் இன்னைக்கு நாம கத்துக்கப் போற EFS. அப்புறம், 'compliance documents-ஐ யாராலும் delete பண்ணவே முடியாதுனு உறுதி பண்ண முடியுமா?'nு பார்ப்போம் - இது Glacier Vault Lock. இதுகூட CS5 Storage-ஓட கடைசி lesson.

lines: Building Basics · Session CS5 · Lesson C5.4
Ticket FQ-189 — closing out with CFO's Office

blocks.block_title: EFS — Shared File Storage Across Multiple Instances
blocks.ava_speaks: EFS (Elastic File System), EBS-ல இருந்து fundamentally வேற - EBS ஒரு volume, ஒரே ஒரு instance-கூட மட்டும் attach ஆகும் (ஒரு சில exceptions தவிர). EFS, multiple EC2 instances-ல இருந்து, simultaneous-ஆ, ஒரே shared filesystem-ஐ mount பண்ண முடியும் - NFS protocol வழியா. ஆனா இந்த flexibility-க்கு ஒரு cost இருக்கு - EFS, per-GB storage cost-ல roughly EBS-ஐ விட 3 மடங்கு அதிகம். அதனால EFS-ஐ, genuinely shared access தேவைப்படற workloads-க்கு மட்டும் use பண்ணணும் - single-instance workloads-க்கு, EBS தான் cheaper, correct choice.

rows: Attaches to a single instance at a time (mostly)
Block storage, lower cost per GB
Network file storage (NFS), roughly 3x EBS cost per GB
Right choice ONLY when genuine multi-instance shared access is needed

board_actions.text: EFS's cost premium is the price of shared access. If a workload doesn't actually need multiple instances reading/writing the same files simultaneously, that premium buys nothing.

inline_questions.question: ஒரு single EC2 instance-ல run ஆகற application-க்கு, extra storage தேவை. EBS-ஆ EFS-ஆ correct choice?
options: A) EFS, ஏன்னா அது more scalable
B) EBS, ஏன்னா single-instance workload-க்கு shared access தேவையே இல்ல, EFS-ஓட extra cost justify ஆகாது
inline_questions.ava_correct: Correct! Single instance-க்கு shared access தேவை இல்ல, அதனால EFS-ஓட 3x cost premium justify ஆகாது - EBS தான் இங்க correct, cost-effective choice.
inline_questions.ava_wrong: இல்ல, EFS 'more scalable' தான், ஆனா அந்த scalability இங்க தேவையே இல்ல. Single instance workload-க்கு, EBS தான் correct - EFS-ஓட extra cost, use பண்ணாத ஒரு feature-க்காக pay பண்றது மாதிரி.

inline_questions.question: EFS, ஒரே சமயத்தில் 10 instances-ல இருந்து mount ஆகி இருக்கு. ஒரு instance ஒரு file update பண்ணா, மற்ற 9 instances-க்கு அது தெரியுமா?
options: A) இல்ல, ஒவ்வொரு instance-க்கும் தனி copy இருக்கும்
B) ஆமா, EFS ஒரே shared filesystem - அனைத்து instances-மும் ஒரே, consistent file view பார்க்கும்
C) Manual sync பண்ணனும், automatic இல்ல
D) EFS ஒரே சமயத்தில் ஒரே ஒரு instance-ல தான் mount ஆகும்
inline_questions.ava_correct: Sari! EFS-ஓட முழு point இதுதான் - ஒரே shared filesystem, எல்லா mounted instances-மும் ஒரே, consistent, real-time file view பார்க்கும்.
inline_questions.ava_wrong: இல்ல, EFS-ஓட core value proposition தான் இது - shared, consistent filesystem, multiple instances simultaneous-ஆ mount பண்ணி, ஒரே files-ஐ real-time-ல பார்க்க முடியும்.

blocks.block_title: Glacier Vault Lock — When 'Delete This' Should Never Be Possible
blocks.ava_speaks: Financial services, healthcare மாதிரி regulated industries-ல, சில records-ஐ ஒரு fixed retention period வரைக்கும், யாராலும் - admin ஆனாலும் சரி - delete அல்லது modify பண்ண முடியாத மாதிரி store பண்ணணும் compliance requirement இருக்கும். இதுதான் WORM (Write Once, Read Many). Glacier Vault Lock, ஒரு Vault Lock policy apply பண்ணி, ஒரு retention period-ஐ lock பண்ணிடும் - அந்த policy apply ஆனப்புறம், அதை AWS root account-ஆல் கூட override பண்ண முடியாது, retention period expire ஆகும் வரைக்கும். FoodQuick-ஓட financial audit records, இந்த level protection தேவைப்படுது.

board_actions.text: Glacier Vault Lock — Immutable by Design

rows: An admin with sufficient permissions can delete or modify objects
Once locked, NO ONE — including AWS account root — can delete or modify before the retention period ends
Compliance relies on process and permissions discipline
Compliance is enforced at the infrastructure level, immune to permission mistakes or insider risk

blocks.block_title: Mounting EFS Across App Servers and Locking a Compliance Vault
blocks.ava_speaks: karthik-dev இப்போ FoodQuick-ஓட shared configuration files-க்கு EFS mount பண்றான், அப்புறம் ananya-analyst financial audit records-க்கு ஒரு Glacier Vault Lock policy apply பண்றாங்க.

steps.ava_narration: EFS Console-ல 'Create file system' click பண்றோம், name 'foodquick-shared-config', VPC-ஆ foodquick-prod-vpc select பண்றோம்.

console_action.highlight: File system name and VPC selection
console_action.result: A new EFS filesystem is created, ready to be mounted from instances in this VPC

steps.ava_narration: Mount targets, ஒவ்வொரு AZ-க்கும் create ஆகும் - foodquick-private-1a, foodquick-private-1b, app servers இருக்கற subnets-ல.

console_action.result: EFS is now reachable from instances in both AZs where app servers live

steps.ava_narration: Instance-க்குள்ள, 'sudo mount -t efs fs-0abc123:/ /mnt/shared-config' run பண்றோம் - இப்போ இந்த instance-ல /mnt/shared-config, shared EFS filesystem-ஐ point பண்ணும்.

console_action.path: Terminal (each app server instance) → sudo mount -t efs fs-0abc123:/ /mnt/shared-config
console_action.result: Multiple app server instances can now read and write to the same shared configuration files simultaneously

steps.ava_narration: இப்போ Glacier side-க்கு போவோம். S3 Glacier Console-ல, foodquick-audit-records vault-ஐ select பண்ணி, 'Lock policy' -> 'Create policy' click பண்றோம்.

console_action.path: S3 Glacier Console → foodquick-audit-records → Lock policy → Create policy
console_action.result: The Vault Lock policy editor opens

steps.ava_narration: Policy-ல, 7 வருடம் (2555 நாள்) retention period define பண்றோம் - இந்த period முடியற வரைக்கும் எந்த object-மும் delete பண்ண முடியாது, root account-ஆ இருந்தாலும் சரி. 'Initiate policy' click பண்றோம்.

console_action.result: The policy enters an in-progress state, requiring confirmation within 24 hours before it becomes permanently locked

expected_outcome.description: App servers now share configuration files via EFS across two AZs, and financial audit records are protected by a Glacier Vault Lock policy that no one can override before the 7-year retention period ends.
expected_outcome.what_to_notice: Vault Lock policy 'Initiate' பண்ணின பிறகு, 24 மணி நேரத்துக்குள்ள 'Complete' பண்ணி confirm பண்ணனும் - இல்லனா அது automatically cancel ஆகிடும். இந்த 24-hour window, தப்பான policy-ஐ accidentally permanently lock பண்றதை தடுக்கும் safety measure.

blocks.block_title: EBS vs EFS Access Patterns, Side by Side
blocks.ava_speaks: இந்த diagram பாரு - EBS-ஓட single-instance attachment-க்கும், EFS-ஓட multi-instance shared access-க்கும் உள்ள வித்தியாசம்.

ascii: EC2 Instance A --- EBS Volume (only A can use this volume)
EC2 Instance B --- EBS Volume (a separate volume, only B can use this)
EC2 Instance B ---> EFS Filesystem (all instances read/write the SAME files simultaneously)

output_preview.ava_narration: EBS-ல, ஒவ்வொரு instance-க்கும் தனி, independent storage - EFS-ல, எல்லாருக்கும் ஒரே shared storage.

blocks.block_title: Your Turn — Choose EBS or EFS for Three Scenarios
blocks.instruction: கீழ இருக்கற 3 scenarios-க்கு, EBS சரியா EFS சரியான்னு தேர்ந்தெடு.
blocks.scenario: Ravi 3 different storage needs list பண்ணி இருக்காங்க: 1) A single database instance needing dedicated, high-performance disk storage. 2) A fleet of 6 web servers behind a load balancer, all of which need to read and write to the same set of uploaded user files simultaneously. 3) A single batch-processing instance's temporary working directory during a job.

starter_state.current_configuration: None of the 3 scenarios have a storage choice assigned yet

requirements: Assign the single database instance to EBS (specifically io2 or gp3 depending on IOPS needs, from the last lesson)
Assign the 6-web-server shared file scenario to EFS, since genuine multi-instance simultaneous access is required
Assign the single batch-processing instance's temporary directory to EBS, since only one instance ever needs it
Explain in each case why the alternative choice would be wrong
hints: Key question ஒவ்வொரு scenario-க்கும்: 'இது genuinely multiple instances-ல இருந்து simultaneous access தேவைப்படுமா?' - இல்லைனா, EBS தான் correct, cheaper choice
6 web servers ஒரே files-ஐ share பண்றது, EFS-ஓட textbook use case - இதுக்கு EBS use பண்ணா, files sync பண்ணுறதுக்கு custom logic தேவைப்படும்
'single instance' phrase எந்த scenario-ல வந்தாலும், அது EBS-ஐ point பண்ணும் ஒரு strong signal - EFS-ஓட shared-access premium அங்க justify ஆகாது

expected_outcome.verifiable_result: Database instance -> EBS, 6 web servers sharing files -> EFS, single batch instance temp directory -> EBS, each with correct reasoning about single vs multi-instance access
expected_outcome.ava_correct: Correct! Genuine shared-access தேவைப்படற ஒரே ஒரு scenario-க்கு மட்டும் EFS தேர்ந்தெடுத்திருக்க - மற்ற ரெண்டும் single-instance, அதனால EBS தான் cost-effective.
expected_outcome.ava_wrong: ஒரு choice தப்பா இருக்கு போல - ஒவ்வொரு scenario-ல, genuinely எத்தனை instances simultaneous-ஆ access பண்ணணும்னு திரும்ப யோசி.

blocks.block_title: EFS Used for a Workload That Never Needed Sharing
blocks.ava_speaks: priya-dev, ஒரு single-instance batch-processing job-க்கு storage set பண்றப்போ, 'EFS scalable-ஆ இருக்கும், future-ல தேவைப்படலாம்'nு நினைச்சு, EFS தேர்ந்தெடுத்தாங்க - அந்த job உண்மையில ஒரே ஒரு instance-ல தான் ஒரு போதும் run ஆகும்.
blocks.setup: priya-dev sets up storage for a nightly batch-processing job that always runs on exactly one instance, choosing EFS 'for future flexibility' even though there's no current or planned need for multi-instance access.
blocks.what_happened: Three months later, a cost review flags this EFS filesystem as an unusually expensive line item for what is, functionally, single-instance temporary working storage — paying roughly 3x the per-GB cost of EBS for a shared-access capability that has never once been used.
blocks.broken_config:
Storage: foodquick-batch-temp-efs (EFS)
Mount targets: 1 (only ever mounted from a single instance, foodquick-batch-processor)
Actual concurrent mounts observed over 3 months: never more than 1
Monthly cost: significantly higher than an equivalent EBS volume would have cost for the same capacity
blocks.error_shown: Cost Explorer finding: foodquick-batch-temp-efs storage cost is 3.1x higher than an equivalent-capacity EBS gp3 volume would cost, with zero evidence of multi-instance access in CloudWatch EFS client connection metrics.
blocks.the_real_problem: 'Future flexibility' ஒரு real, immediate need இல்லாம, ஒரு premium feature-க்கு pay பண்ற காரணமா இருக்கக் கூடாது. EFS-ஓட cost premium, ஒரு specific capability (shared, simultaneous multi-instance access)-க்கான cost - அந்த capability use ஆகாத வரைக்கும், அது வெறும் unnecessary extra cost தான்.

fix.corrected_config: Migrate the batch job's temporary storage from EFS to a standard EBS gp3 volume attached directly to foodquick-batch-processor. If genuine multi-instance access becomes a real requirement in the future, EFS can be adopted at that point, when the need actually exists.
fix.result: Storage cost for this workload drops by roughly two-thirds, with no loss of functionality, since the job never used or needed shared access in the first place.

blocks.lesson: 'Future-ல தேவைப்படலாம்'nு, ஒரு real தேவை இல்லாம, ஒரு premium storage option தேர்ந்தெடுக்கறது, unnecessary recurring cost-ஆ மாறும் - EFS-ஐ, genuine, current, multi-instance shared access தேவைப்படும்போது மட்டும் தேர்ந்தெடு.

blocks.block_title: Judgment Round — Storage Choice and Compliance

challenges.question: A company applies a Glacier Vault Lock policy with a 7-year retention period, then a week later realizes they made an error in which records were included. Can they simply delete or modify the locked vault to fix the mistake?
challenges.answer: No — that's the entire point of Vault Lock. Once a lock policy is completed (confirmed after the 24-hour window), it cannot be altered or removed by anyone, including AWS account root, until the retention period expires. This is why the 24-hour 'in progress' window before finalizing exists — to catch mistakes BEFORE the lock becomes permanent.

challenges.question: A team has 3 EC2 instances behind a load balancer, each currently maintaining its own separate local copy of uploaded user files, requiring a custom sync process to keep them consistent. What would switching to EFS eliminate?
challenges.answer: It would eliminate the need for the custom sync process entirely — all 3 instances would read and write to the same shared filesystem directly, always seeing the same, consistent set of files without any additional synchronization logic.

challenges.question: A regulated company needs financial records to be tamper-proof for exactly 5 years, then automatically eligible for deletion afterward per their data retention policy. Does Glacier Vault Lock support this, or does it require records to be kept forever?
challenges.answer: Vault Lock supports exactly this — the retention period is configurable to whatever length compliance requires (5 years here), and after that period ends, normal deletion becomes possible again. It's not permanent forever-storage, just enforced immutability for the specified window.

blocks.block_title: How Teams Decide Between EBS, EFS, and S3 for a New Workload
blocks.ava_speaks: Real companies-ல, storage service தேர்ந்தெடுக்கறது ஒரு quick decision framework follow பண்ணும் - 'flexibility future-ல தேவைப்படலாம்' மாதிரி vague reasoning-ஐ நம்பாம.

workflow_steps.action: Ask: does this data need to be accessed by multiple instances simultaneously, right now or in a concretely planned near-term feature?
workflow_steps.detail: 'ஆமா, concretely'nு பதில் வந்தால் மட்டும் EFS consider பண்ணு - vague 'future-ல தேவைப்படலாம்' போதாது

workflow_steps.action: If the data is really objects (files accessed via URL/API, not needing filesystem semantics), consider S3 instead of either EBS or EFS
workflow_steps.detail: இது C5.1a-ல கத்துக்கிட்ட bucket/object model-ஐ, correct use case-க்கு direct பண்ணும்

workflow_steps.action: For compliance-critical data with legal retention requirements, evaluate Glacier Vault Lock early in the design, not as an afterthought retrofitted later
workflow_steps.detail: Retention requirements, storage architecture-ஐ affect பண்ணும் - இதை ஆரம்பத்திலேயே கணக்கில் எடுக்கறது நல்லது

tools_shown.use: On-premises applications-க்கு, S3-ஐ ஒரு file interface-ஆ expose பண்ணி, hybrid storage scenarios-ல உதவும் (context-க்காக, இது இன்னைக்கு live_build-ல பயன்படுத்தல)

tools_shown.tool: Cost Explorer, filtered by storage service
tools_shown.use: EFS, EBS, S3 costs-ஐ தனித்தனியா track பண்ணி, priya-dev-ஓட mistake மாதிரி unnecessary premium storage usage-ஐ கண்டுபிடிக்க உதவும்

lesson_summary.ava_speaks: Super! இன்னைக்கு நாம EFS எப்படி multiple instances-க்கு shared access தரும்னு, அதோட 3x cost premium ஏன் irjustifyக்கப்படணும்னு, Glacier Vault Lock எப்படி true WORM compliance தரும்னு கத்துக்கிட்டோம். இதுகூட CS5 Storage முடிஞ்சிடுச்சு - S3 basics-ல இருந்து ஆரம்பிச்சு, storage classes, security, EBS, EFS, Vault Lock வரைக்கும் full storage foundation கட்டிட்டோம். CFO-ஓட FQ-189 ticket-ஓட phase complete. அடுத்த session-ல நாம CS6 Monitoring-க்கு போவோம்.

board.title: Lesson C5.4 — Summary
points: ✓ EFS provides shared, simultaneous access to the same filesystem across multiple EC2 instances
✓ EFS costs roughly 3x more per GB than EBS — a premium that only pays off with genuine multi-instance access needs
✓ Glacier Vault Lock enforces true WORM compliance — locked policies cannot be overridden by anyone, including root, until retention expires
✓ The 24-hour Vault Lock 'in progress' window exists specifically to catch mistakes before a lock becomes permanent
✓ Choosing EFS for 'future flexibility' with no concrete multi-instance need turns a premium feature into pure unnecessary cost
